subject_group: 9.6.3 Emergency ground, ditching, and water egress

versions.text:
Standard: Emergency exits are indicated with markings and instructions IAW 14 CFR 25.811 Emergency Exit Marking. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine drawings or digital models and verify that emergency exit marking and instructions are IAW the standard.
(2) Examine the physical air vehicle and verify that the emergency exit instructions and markings are IAW the standard.
